card.name: Start of drug names beginning Tr
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug or brand name that begins with "tr" or "TR", such as trastuzumab, TRUQAP, TRADJENTA, TRULICITY or TRAZIMERA. It is often right after a section heading or "of" or "Withhold".

modes.label: Capitalized brand names
modes.description: Upper-case opening piece of a brand name at the start of a sentence or after a heading.

modes.label: Generic names
modes.description: Lower-case opening piece of a generic drug or class name starting with tr.
